values: model point values of js/model_sg.js, no prior range; data/archetypes_sg.json with the calibrated overrides merged by js/archetype_sg.js loadArchetypes

calibration.source: EMA SES Table 3.5, 2018–2019, with NEA_HECS2017 as a prior on the AC share (this study)

grid: SVY21 / Singapore TM (EPSG:3414, js/svy21.js), 100 m cells, keys "<x>_<y>" with x = floor(E / 100), y = floor(N / 100), by the centre of each building

units.AF: m² reference area (HDB flat area, dwelling area of condominiums and landed houses, GFA otherwise)
units.GFA: m² gross floor area (residential: footprint × storeys)

window: r = 0: the cell itself; r = 1: sums of the 3 × 3 neighbourhood (300 m); r = 2: 5 × 5 (500 m); the first window with at least minN modelled buildings is used

check.note: model electricity of the typical year (GWh/a) against EMA SES 2026 Table 3.4 (households, annual) and Table 3.2 (commerce and services); a check, not a calibration
